concept.dimension_basis: Component dimensions are the installed extent of the explicitly enumerated family. Individual print-type dimensions and quantities are carried by the current source entries and README; actual extents and occurrence membership come from the hash-bound current inventory. The closed-panel concept envelope conservatively adds the full18 mm plunger pull to the exact neutral world extents. Open-door and service clearances are separate operating requirements.
concept.interaction: Launch one screened marble with the replaceable-band plunger, use either thumb flipper independently, and change the five bolted mission pieces between two documented routes. A skill shot enters the raised sample bucket; the free marble weight tips the common bucket and flag. Open the captive reset door and transfer the stopped marble through its side-wall grip reliefs into the adjacent hopper, allowing empty gravity return. The covered chute and drain feed the pickup cup for manual relaunch. Three launches, crater points and a ten-point jackpot create repeatable scored play.

novel_mechanisms.definition: Two independent 46 degree blade/thumb rotors on 7 mm printed flanged sleeves around M4 cores, with covered replaceable-band returns.
18 mm hard-stopped sliding launcher with an open-top assembly guide, shielded replaceable band and three geometric anchor settings.

A free marble loads a bucket physically continuous with its landing-flag arm; the common rocker pivots about board datum144,376,26 through minus28 degrees, with empty restoring torque set by a solid trim at localY minus42.
Three bolted craters and two curved guide modules change rolling routes between two coordinate-defined missions.
Manual marble transfer unloads the rocker and feeds a covered under-deck return into the front pickup cup.

concept.summary: Build a lunar pinball arcade with independent thumb flippers, movable crater routes and a marble-weight sample-bucket jackpot that raises a real connected landing flag.

design_changes.current_choice: Two captive hinged loading/reset doors, indexed lift-turn latches, sidewall finger relief, rebalanced trim at localY minus42 and strike face flush atY70

design_changes.reason: Ordinary replay needs retained access hardware and geometric hand clearance. Current path, balance, print and retention checks must qualify these repairs before release.

design_changes.current_choice: Forward pickup station, full-thickness corner openings and4 mm east-wall expansion providing a downhill corridor beside the existing return hood
design_changes.previous_choice: Pickup cup with thin rounded finger relief and an obstructed central-drain floor route
design_changes.reason: Exact sphere and finger checks exposed both thin wall remnants and a blocked drain approach. The wider corridor preserves mounting datums and uses the existing hood as a geometric guide; actual rolling and settling still require commissioning.

design_changes.current_choice: Small open-top exterior nut-clearance notch retaining the inner cup wall and marble corridor
design_changes.previous_choice: Widened cup exterior touching the fifth flipper-guard nut
design_changes.reason: The native mount gate and both mission static checks identified one exact collision. The qualified cut preserves the working cup surfaces and gives the catalog nut 0.25 mm clearance with 1.70 mm retained wall; physical fit remains subject to commissioning.

See design/nut-validation-r7-recovery/HANDOFF.md and current native/inventory/balance evidence; no physical-fit claim follows.
